methods.GetPortPosition: () -> OceanPoint copy of Config.ship.start, independent of departure

return_semantics.success: true after ResetAtPosition on the existing Movement/ship

side_effects: Moves the current ship to the authored port
Clears movement target and collision push feedback; reanchors camera
Does not replace World/ship, settle a day, advance time, refresh fish, change pause/scope, replace signals, or remove/move the fixed barrel
contracts.owner_boundary: Gameplay decides whether a flow requires port reset; ordinary return must sail through the existing 10m gate

methods.GetFixedBarrel: () -> nil | read-only snapshot {id, contentId, generation, position}

return_semantics.success: true, nil only for the exact live registered driftwood barrel, matching generation, valid ship point and distance <= configured operateDistance (5m)

side_effects: Getter returns copied values behind read-only proxies; no entity or mutable position leaks
Interaction check is spatial validation only and does not start an action, pause, charge, reward or save
World creation increments process-local barrelGeneration; daily ordinary-fish refresh and port reset preserve it
contracts.owner_boundary: Gameplay owns progress/payment/reward and should not serialize process-local generation

methods.GetFishingTarget: (id) -> current entity | nil; entity reference, read only by caller
methods.GetFishingGeneration: () -> integer; increments on fish reset/refresh and Runtime reset

return_semantics.selection: Uses configured net radius and cast-distance validation; nearest eligible fish or nil; hidden/frozen fish remain eligible, locked fish do not
return_semantics.lock: Requires exact table owner identity; repeat lock by same owner succeeds; other owner is rejected
return_semantics.unlock: Valid token on missing/unlocked fish is idempotent true; mismatched token is false
return_semantics.remove: Locked fish requires exact owner; successful removal is the only caught removal; wrong supplied owner is false
return_semantics.restore: Only same World, fishing generation, and exact target object; refuses a conflicting current owner

side_effects: Lock pauses fish FSM/movement, prevents predation and repeat selection, and clears the source's surface cues
Remove updates the one World registry, clears capture ownership/overlaps/cues, and marks the entity removed
Restore can reinsert the original fish and behavior after failed transaction; snapshot contains live World/entity references and is mutable
contracts.owner_boundary: Gameplay owns transaction/token/payment/reward and may hold snapshot only for same-transaction rollback; Ocean owns fish state and registry mutations

contracts.return_semantics: Setter assigns enabled == true and returns the assigned state; false means a successful disable when false was requested, and also means malformed non-true inputs were safely closed
contracts.side_effects: Persistent visibility only; no pause, clock, fish, or simulation update
contracts.owner_boundary: Gameplay owns the permanent lens treasure/eligibility; Ocean is source of truth for current visibility. Closing observation does not consume or remove the treasure. Caller verifies desired state via IsScopeEnabled() == desired

methods.SeaDraw.Scene: (ctx, width, height, runtime, clock, fishingView, isLocationRecognized)

contracts.return_semantics: Bootstrap reads callbacks during Render and forwards values in fixed fifth/sixth/seventh argument positions; each is optional
contracts.side_effects: Clock phase selects night overlay; fishing phase/elapsed selects only visual depiction; recognition query selects visible barrel appearance only
contracts.owner_boundary: Gameplay retains all live values and mutation rights; Draw/Render must not retain or mutate gameplay state

methods.onSeaPointer: (worldPosition, runtime, bootstrap) -> true consumes; false/nil permits navigation fallback
methods.Stop: () -> idempotently unsubscribe and release Bootstrap-owned resources

contracts.return_semantics: Only exact callback result true consumes; a valid unconsumed sea point sets Movement target and HandlePointer returns true
contracts.side_effects: Mouse/touch share pointer path; pause/viewport/UI/water guards run before interaction; consumed input prevents Bootstrap's click-to-move fallback, while the B callback may legitimately clear an existing target through ClearMovementTarget
contracts.owner_boundary: Integration syncs pause before guard and owns interaction; Ocean input adapter owns only target fallback and its event subscriptions

methods.Game.World:AddSystem: (system, cadence?) -> true if newly registered; false if same object already registered
methods.Game:GetWorld: () -> current runtime.world; calls AddSystem(gameplaySystem, frame) as an idempotent registration side effect
methods.Ocean.World:Retire: () -> true once, false thereafter; clears entities/systems and detaches signal world
methods.Runtime:Reset: () -> retires old World and creates a new Runtime World
methods.Runtime:refreshOrdinaryFish: (daySeed, departure?) -> refreshes fish/temporary objects within existing World

contracts.return_semantics: Ocean.World inherits the single Game.World entity registry and scheduler. Runtime initialization adds EntityStateSystem and SurfaceSignals as simulation systems; AddSystem deduplicates by system object and rejects cadence changes
contracts.side_effects: Game:GetWorld may add the one Gameplay frame system; repeated calls on same World are deduplicated. Current NewRun uses ResetShipAtPort plus ordinary-fish refresh and preserves World. An independent Runtime:Reset call retires old World; daily fish refresh does not replace World
contracts.owner_boundary: Game/World owns scheduler; Gameplay clock advances once per frame; Ocean simulation may substep. Call Game:GetWorld only after Game initialization. Current NewRun must retain the same World; reacquire only after an independent Runtime.Reset replacement

compatibility_check.facade_fixture: Construct Bridge.New with a real Runtime, then replace only bridge.runtime with a method-only proxy rejecting world/ship/movement reads. Keep bridge.game.runtime real. Execute the actual NewRun/preparation path; receipt obtains generation through GetFishingGeneration(). Architecture suite passes.
compatibility_check.scope_limit: Post-construction Bridge public-method compatibility only, not arbitrary facade injection during Bridge.New. Game:GetWorld lifecycle/deduplicated registration is tested separately. Formal NewRun preserves World; independent Runtime.Reset replaces it.
compatibility_check.known_absence: SeaRuntime has no generic public GetWorld/GetWorldIdentity. Prepared receipts need only the provided GetFishingGeneration method; Game:GetWorld is the composition current-World getter with deduplicated registration.
